khai.tagline: Weather as process: the atmospheric force a place undergoes, channel by channel and band by band, moving what the place shows before anyone speaks.

card.wire: Attaches at Place, on the Shown chapter. The root (process_weather.md) declares weather as a loop a place runs whenever its sky turns: a front arrives and the place's conditions begin to move, felt on every face at once before anyone speaks. Weather moves only what space already set; it never re-owns the setting.
card.issue: Six channels, each its own load. Wind, water, heat, cold, and sky are the transient loads a place undergoes; season runs underneath, standing, never arriving. Each transient channel climbs one intensity ladder of four bands, from a load the place tempers without effort to a load it cannot temper at all (sky climbs three); season does not climb, it holds the resting floor the transient channels relax toward. One channel may sit at a different band than another at the same moment.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the engine. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so the weather-world reads system-wide and no place escapes it. The link: each place carries, under Shown, the condition it is under, linking the channel and the band it presents.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; the read is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared and each weathered place links a real channel file at a declared band under Shown. Whether the band is true to the place is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite. The place shows the load; it does not narrate it, and it never mirrors a persona's feeling.
card.setup: Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Then give each place its read under Shown: link the channel and band the front has brought. Season sets the floor each channel relaxes toward, so a dormant-tilt place sits colder and darker at rest. Read it in the first beat; the place enacts the load, never announces it.
